name: write_file
description: Write a text file into the workspace, creating it or replacing one already there. Use when a result has to land on disk rather than in the answer.

path.description: Path to write, relative to the workspace root (e.g. "notes/summary.md"). Absolute paths are accepted but must still resolve inside the workspace root. The parent directory has to exist already.

content.description: The file's contents, written verbatim. No newline is added, so end it with one if the file should have a final newline.

overwrite.description: Replace a file that is already there. Left false, an existing path is refused rather than clobbered.

output_schema.description: One line of the form "wrote N bytes to <path>", with no trailing newline.

exit_codes.2: invalid input (stdin was not a JSON object, or a parameter is missing or the wrong type)
exit_codes.3: no such directory (the path's parent does not exist; this tool does not create directories)
exit_codes.4: not permitted (the path resolves outside the workspace root, is not a regular file, or is not writable)
exit_codes.5: already exists (the path is there and overwrite was not set)
